fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.3 preserves the mirror-only OCum model and owner-authored live visibility, but fixes the remaining STR proxy rendering bug at the actual geometry binding layer. Owner-visible Body [OvlN] nodes now copy the vertex descriptor and current NiSkinInstance from the proxy's live FaceGenRGBTint body geometry before visibility is applied, replacing the ineffective RevertOverlay material-only repair. Local OCum rendering, PPA, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
